description.value: Circle K is a major international convenience store and fuel station chain with a location on 200 Street in the Township of Langley. This location offers fresh grab-and-go food, roller grill items, coffee, and public restrooms, giving touring cyclists a practical mid-ride stop. As a branded chain store, it offers predictable product availability including snacks, drinks, and packaged goods.

Services explicitly listed on the store page include Fresh Food Fast, Coffee, Roller Grill, and Public Restrooms, confirming hot food and washroom amenities. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, device charging, ice, camping fuel, or water bottle refill appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null.
